title: TrueNorth locale bundle
description: One locale's UI string table, `content/locales/<locale>/<bundle>.json`. This is the on-disk shape and the shape the i18n adapter hands to the application - the adapter no longer attaches the locale, the file declares it. Bundles hold engine and UI vocabulary reused across content (menus, settings, overlays, live-region templates, locomotion mode labels). Text that belongs to one content document - a level title, a POI blurb, a question prompt, a dialogue line - lives in that document instead (ADR-0010).

strings.description: Flat dotted keys to translated strings. Flat, not nested: the key is the contract between a screen and a translator, and a nested tree lets the same key be spelled two ways. EN/FR parity across the pair of files is checked by make validate-content.
